title: Pipeline Operations
description: Observation volume, freshness and rejected records of the vitals pipeline. Synthetic data; not for patient care.

panels.title: Observations per hour
panels.description: Accepted observations by vital, per UTC hour of measurement.

targets.sql: select date_trunc('hour', effective_datetime) as "time", observation_type as metric, count(*) as observations from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_observations where $__timeFilter(effective_datetime) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Latest observation
panels.description: Freshness: the newest measurement and the newest receipt in the warehouse.

targets.sql: select max(effective_datetime) as latest_measured, max(received_at) as latest_received from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_observations

panels.title: Observations by vital
panels.description: Accepted observations in the selected range.

targets.sql: select observation_type, count(*) as observations from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_observations where $__timeFilter(effective_datetime) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Encounters with a complete NEWS2
panels.description: Encounters whose feature window has all seven NEWS2 parameters.

targets.sql: select sum(case when news2_total is null then 0 else 1 end) as complete, count(*) as encounters from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_encounter_news2

panels.title: Rejected records by reason
panels.description: Records the processing step quarantined, by reason. May be empty.

targets.sql: select rejection_reason, count(*) as records from @@RAW@@.@@QUARANTINE@@ where $__timeFilter(received_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc
